item.text:
Implemented Task 005: active project task rows now have a `New task title` textbox and `Rename task` button. Renaming trims the title, preserves task identity and completion state, and updates the completion checkbox label. Archived projects disable the controls, and the API rejects rename requests for archived projects.

Verified with Node.js 22.22.1, `GET /health`, and API requests creating and renaming a task. `git diff --check` passed, and the working tree is clean.
